eyebrow: The vulnerability — a price an attacker can move
caption: A flash loan removes capital as a constraint — borrow millions for ~15 seconds.

steps.label: Borrow + dump
steps.sub: flash loan skews the Curve pool's price

steps.label: Deposit
steps.sub: vault prices the deposit at the skewed rate

steps.label: Trade back + withdraw
steps.sub: pool reverts, vault overpays the attacker

eyebrow: The fix — make the price source expensive to move
caption: Nothing was a reentrancy bug — every call completed and returned normally.

subtitle: When the manipulated market is the oracle itself.
